personalInfo.name: Khushboo Singh
personalInfo.eyebrow: NLP · Machine Learning · Computational Social Science
personalInfo.title: ML and NLP Researcher building human-centered language technologies.
personalInfo.summary: I build NLP and machine learning systems that transform language, speech, and behavioral signals into meaningful human-centered insights, combining rigorous AI research with real-world LLM evaluation and scalable ML engineering.
personalInfo.about: I am an ML and NLP Researcher working at Vanderbilt University’s Human Language Analysis Beings (HLAB), where I work at the intersection of natural language processing, machine learning, and computational social science. My research focuses on language-based psychological and behavioral assessment, transformer and LLM representations, multimodal modeling, and scalable NLP tools. I earned my M.S. in Computer Science from Stony Brook University in 2025 and bring more than three years of software engineering experience to research systems that need to work beyond the lab.

professionalExperience.organization: Vanderbilt University · Human Language Analysis Beings (HLAB)
description: Contribute to a $4M, 24-month initiative developing multimodal machine learning for PTSD treatment response, safety-risk assessment, and treatment pathways.
Develop audio and text deep-learning pipelines, multimodal fusion models, standardized embeddings, and reusable feature-extraction APIs.
Led longitudinal NLP analyses over 10K+ ecological momentary assessment texts using LDA, contextual embeddings, and temporal correlations.
Built Whisper and Transformer-based ASR/NLP pipelines for 10K+ speech samples to study language signals associated with PTSD, PHQ-9 depression, and AUDIT alcohol-use indicators.

professionalExperience.organization: Meta Reality Labs · Seattle, WA · via Software Galaxy System
description: Evaluated Ray-Ban Meta Glasses voice-assistant and on-device LLM behavior, reducing Invocation Failure Rate from 9.35% to 3.96% (57.7%) and False Capture Rate from 12.12% to 7.67% (36.7%).
Built F1-based evaluation across 9+ domains and developed multilingual NI/NLU data patches for invocation, intent recognition, and domain-routing quality.
Built 5+ production machine-learning systems serving 10K+ users, improving engagement by up to 30%.
Developed a LangChain/OpenAI conversational assistant that automated 70%+ of support queries and reduced response latency by 60%.

academicProjects.title: Transformer Representations for Human States & Traits
academicProjects.summary: Systematic evaluation of language-model representations for psychological human-centered NLP across multiple temporal levels.
highlights: Benchmarked 13 Transformer/LLM models across 43 psychological outcomes using PyTorch and stratified 10-fold Ridge Regression.
Achieved Pearson r ≈ 0.6 for mental-health outcomes and r > 0.7 for personality traits; explored hierarchical embeddings and instruction-tuned LLaMA 3.

academicProjects.title: LegiMed AI
academicProjects.summary: Agentic retrieval-augmented generation for legally relevant medical-document analysis and summarization.
highlights: Built FAISS approximate-nearest-neighbor retrieval with cross-encoder reranking and chain-of-thought prompting.
Evaluated response quality with LLM-as-a-judge workflows and domain-focused retrieval.

academicProjects.title: Multi-LLM Privacy Policy Annotation & GDPR Compliance
academicProjects.summary: Automated privacy-policy analysis for identifying personal-data practices and compliance-relevant language.
highlights: Combined multiple LLM-based annotation strategies with structured privacy-policy analysis.
Achieved 85% accuracy in identifying personal-data mentions and compliance-relevant discrepancies.
